द्रौपदी

DRAUPADĪ . pāñcālī, the wife of the pāṇḍavas. (See under pāñcālī).

द्रौपदीहरण पर्व

DRAUPADĪHARAṆA PARVA . A sub section of Vana Parva in the mahābhārata. This covers Chapters 262 to 271 of Vana Parva.

द्रौपदीसत्यभामासंवाद पर्व

DRAUPADĪSATYABHĀMĀSAṀVĀDA PARVA . A sub section of Vana Parva, in the mahābhārata. This comprises Chapters 233 to 235 of Vana Parva.
